{{Quote|This Lantillian short hauler, dubbed ''Cutter's Way'' is in prime condition.|[[Fiz Cor'gril]] trying to sell the ship|<ref name="AJ9" />}}
'''''Cutter's Way''''' was a [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 short hauler]] that was part of the stock of [[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A previous owner had started the conversion of this [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] into a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] and could be outfitted to serve as either one, or both. Before it landed in the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Fiz Cor'gril]]'s shipyard it had been heavily modified with increased shields and armaments among other things.

==Description==
''Cutter's Way'' was a modified space yacht that was 27 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length. It boasted a slightly more powerful engine then a stock model capable of reaching speeds of 850 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|km/h]] in atmosphere. Its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] had also been upgraded to a Class 1.0 speed. The backup hyperdrive remained the same at a Class 15.0. It boasted heavier [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and was protected by three turreted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. Two of the laser cannons were fire linked while the third was a light laser cannon. It took a crew of two and could carry up to six passengers and had consumables good for a single [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. Its cargo bays were slightly smaller then a stock ship at only 80 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]]. It came equipped with [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]], lifesupport, and a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]].<ref name="AJ9" />

The ship was equipped with an unusual modification, a [[power flux surger]] that would allow it to boost either shields or weapons by up to 50% at the expense of other systems. The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Garginoolaara]], who worked at [[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships]] was able to fix most of the bugs in the surger. Originally the device would blow out the other systems but Garginoolaara was able to reduce that to just drawing power away to the other systems.<ref name="AJ9" />

==History==
While its prior ownership is unknown, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it was for sale by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Fiz Cor'gril]] at his shop on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trevi IV]]. He had it for sale for 55,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Garginoolaara had originally wanted to remove the experimental power flux surger from the ship but Cor'gril was able to get him to settle for just fixing the broken system instead.<ref name="AJ9" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Cutter's Way'' was designed by [[John J. Richardson III]] for the article [[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships (article)|''Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships'']] that was published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 9]] in February [[1996]]. It was published as a supplement to the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] created by [[West End Games]].
